title: Actionable route
caption: Follow an immediately reachable alternative route.

title: Delayed route
caption: Wait until the requested turn becomes locally actionable.

title: Locally invalid intention
caption: Reject a direction unsupported by the local road topology.

title: After route commitment
caption: Continue along the committed route despite a changed intention.

title: Feasible lane change
caption: Respond to a reachable adjacent-lane intention.

title: Ongoing lane change
caption: Preserve the continuity of a lateral maneuver already in progress.
